individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (time-lapse photoactivation frames) with no quantitative plot; the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity vs time (raw measurement points with fitted diffusion model curves) and insets that are also point/line plots over time. Line and scatter plots are exempt from requiring an overlay of individual data points since the plotted points are themselves the individual measurements.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only micrograph images, no error bars are present.

FAIL - The insets in panel B display averaged early time-point responses with visible error bars, but the caption only states that insets 'represent average early time points responses' without defining what the error bars denote (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
